name: Cebu Masters 2017

venue.name: [Banilad Town Center](http://www.everythingcebu.com/entertainment/shopping-and-malls/banilad-town-centre-charm-and-convenience/)
venue.address: Gov. M. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City, Cebu
venue.details: Day 1 is on the the 1st floor lobby; Day 2 is on the 2nd floor lobby

information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation and raffle entry) starts at Php 300.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on October 15, 2017 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no refund and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
